title: LoadingState
description: Chargement de page, de route ou de section : un spinner ProgressIndicator décoratif à côté d'un libellé visible, dans une seule région de statut polie.

wc:minerva-loading-state.summary: Loading placeholder for a page, route or section.
wc:minerva-loading-state.description: Page / route / section loading presentation (`<LoadingState>` of React): a decorative spinner next to a visible label, inside a single polite status region. It does not set `aria-busy`: mark the content container busy yourself.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Visible text, also announced by the status region (default: localized "Loading...")

properties.name: size
properties.description: Minimum height: small (section), medium (page / route) or large

parts.name: spinner
parts.description: The decorative spinner (wraps a ProgressIndicator in React; the <minerva-progress> element in the web components)

cssProperties.name: --loading-state-gap
cssProperties.description: Space between the spinner and the label

cssProperties.name: --loading-state-min-height
cssProperties.description: Minimum height (every size; defaults to the height of the size)

cssProperties.name: --loading-state-color
cssProperties.description: Color of the label and the spinner

vars.name: --loading-state-gap
vars.description: Space between the spinner and the label

vars.name: --loading-state-min-height
vars.description: Minimum height (every size; defaults to the height of the size)

vars.name: --loading-state-color
vars.description: Color of the label and the spinner

examples.title: Utilisation de base
examples.description: Un indicateur rotatif à côté d'un libellé visible (« Chargement... » localisé par défaut) dans une région status polie.
